name: HEXCARE
recent: Hextar Healthcare 在 2026 年 11 月 27 日公布季度业绩，因手套厂减值导致净亏损扩大至 9660 万令吉。公司同日发布另一则公告，内容未在标题中披露。
notable: 季度净亏损扩大至 9660 万令吉，主要因手套厂减值。
risks: 季度净亏损扩大至 9660 万令吉，主要因手套厂减值。
earnings: 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度营收为 3024.6 万令吉，环比下降 2.6%，同比下降 22.9%；净亏损 954.9 万令吉，净利率 -31.6%，较上季 -9.4% 扩大。

recent_en: Hextar Healthcare announced its quarterly results on 27 November 2026, with net loss widening to RM96.6 million due to glove plant impairment. The company also issued another announcement on the same day, the content of which was not disclosed in the title.
notable_en: Quarterly net loss widened to RM96.6 million, mainly due to glove plant impairment.
risks_en: Quarterly net loss widened to RM96.6 million, mainly due to glove plant impairment.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM30.246 million, down 2.6% QoQ and 22.9% YoY; net loss was RM9.549 million with a net margin of -31.6%, widening from -9.4% in the previous quarter.
